title: E2EE detection rule is circular: plaintext types must be enumerated
description: The spec says omit bodySnippet when bodyType 'is not one of the plaintext types listed in supportedBodyTypes as a plaintext type.' But supportedBodyTypes is the set of types the server accepts, not a classification of what is encrypted. A server that accepts both text/plain and application/mls-ciphertext lists both. The plaintext types must be enumerated explicitly: text/plain, text/markdown, application/jmap-chat-rich.
